test_is_monotonic_increasing: test the is_monotonic_increasing property on a grouped pandas Series with numeric values
test_is_monotonic_decreasing: test the is_monotonic_decreasing property on a grouped pandas Series with numeric values
test_groupby_monotonic_with_inf: test is_monotonic_increasing and is_monotonic_decreasing on grouped data containing inf values
